passport_validity_rule: Valid passport required; Embassy publishes no fixed 6-month minimum.

Transit requirements depend on airside/landside transit; a destination-country visa must be obtained first where required. Applications are lodged through VFS Global Bangladesh, not directly at the Embassy. visa_requirement_type: Visitor visa (subclass 600) – Tourist stream (apply outside Australia)
maximum_permitted_stay: Usually 3 months; up to 12 months in some cases; as granted.
passport_validity_rule: Valid passport or travel document required; no fixed 6-month minimum stated by Home Affairs.
blank_passport_pages_rule: No fixed blank-page count published; upload clear biodata and identity pages.
return_ticket_rule: No universal return-ticket document requirement; demonstrate funds to leave Australia.
proof_of_funds_rule: Sufficient funds for stay and departure; evidence can include 3-month itemised bank statements, payslips, tax records, audited accounts, term deposits or credit-card statements.
accommodation_rule: Provide travel and accommodation plans; a host invitation should state relationship, purpose, duration and accommodation if applicable.
travel_insurance_rule: Strongly recommended; visa condition 8501 may require adequate health insurance.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: Must meet the health requirement; medical examinations may be requested; character requirements also apply.
transit_rule: Check Transit visa subclass 771; Transit Without Visa is conditional and passport-specific; do not assume exemption.
application_channel: Apply online through ImmiAccount; applicant must be outside Australia at application and decision; biometrics may be requested.
application_fee: AUD 250 per applicant (offshore Subclass 600 Tourist stream); health, biometrics and provider charges may be extra.
processing_time: Live Home Affairs guide for subclass 600; recent decisions only, not guaranteed.
required_documents: Passport biodata page and requested identity pages|National identity card and name-change documents if relevant|Itemised personal bank statements for three months|Payslips, tax records, audited accounts, term deposits or credit-card statements as relevant|Travel itinerary and accommodation arrangements|Host invitation with relationship, purpose, duration and support details if visiting friends or family|Evidence of employment, education, family ties and intention to return|Health examinations, police certificates or biometrics if requested

review_notes: Fee status: current Home Affairs guidance lists the offshore Subclass 600 base application charge from AUD 250; the current Migration Regulations compilation confirms AUD 250 for a non-Frequent Traveller, non-Pacific passport holder applying outside Australia. Bangladesh is not a Pacific regional country. Health examinations, police certificates, biometrics and any provider services may create separate costs. Processing status: the official Home Affairs global guide is dynamic and based on recently decided applications; it is indicative, not a guarantee, so no fixed numeric processing time is represented. Bangladeshi ordinary passport holders should apply for Visitor visa subclass 600 Tourist stream; ETA/eVisitor are separate passport-restricted categories. The visa is applied for online and digitally linked to the passport. Stay is usually up to 3 months, with longer periods up to 12 months possible in some cases; single or multiple entry is as granted. A valid passport is required, but Home Affairs publishes no universal six-month minimum or fixed blank-page count. Applicants must be genuine visitors, meet health and character requirements, and have sufficient funds for the stay and departure. Evidence may include three months of itemised bank statements, payslips, audited accounts, tax records, term deposits or credit-card statements. Return tickets are not a universal document requirement; proof of funds to leave Australia is relevant. Travel/ accommodation plans and host invitation details may be requested. Health insurance is strongly recommended and condition 8501 may require it. Transit visa subclass 771 or another valid visa may be required; Transit Without Visa is conditional and passport-specific. Apply through ImmiAccount from outside Australia and remain outside until decision; biometrics may be requested. Checked 2026-11-14.
